features.name: Power Grids, Generators, Nodes & Batteries
features.notes: PowerGraph and GraphUpdater ticks are verified in the ARM11 probe. The live draw set includes the complete stock PowerBlock family (generators, reactors, batteries, diodes and lights), and the host reference asserts every member explicitly (UPSTREAM_STOCK_LIVE_POWER_DRAW tested=26); PowerNode beams remain covered. The stock selected-building power bar is wired in the offline and live clients from Block.setBars, with host checks for dry, partial, buffered and supplied-idle states. Software complete.

features.name: Liquid Pumps, Conduits, Routers & Bridges
features.notes: The ARM11 probe verifies LiquidModule and Conduit simulation. The offline renderer draws original pumps and liquid routers, including the tested Mechanical Pump and Liquid Tank. Live conduit tiling is verified. The stock Bridge Conduit and Phase Conduit are liquid-category LiquidBridge blocks; the host LIQUID registry renders every one of the 21 stock liquid blocks (UPSTREAM_STOCK_LIVE_LIQUID_DRAW tested=21). The host reference verifies one-way Bridge Conduit and Phase Conduit transfer and rejects back-linked pairs (UPSTREAM_LIQUID_BRIDGE_REFERENCE bridgeMilli=100000 phaseMilli=100000 backLink=rejected), dumps a Liquid Router into an adjacent router sink (UPSTREAM_LIQUID_ROUTER_REFERENCE movedMilli=60000 initialMilli=120000 remainingMilli=60000), and checks Liquid Junction far-side/dead-end routing (UPSTREAM_LIQUID_JUNCTION_REFERENCE route=far deadEnd=self). The offline and live replays drew the pumps, conduits, router and both bridge spans on both Azahar profiles from stock saves and the unmodified v160.8 server. The stock selected-building dynamic and keyed consumer/generator liquid bars are wired in the offline and live clients from Block.addLiquidBar; their draw is included in the New 3DS acceptance run. Software complete; only physical-hardware frame-time residue remains (docs/hardware-test-queue.md).

Host wave-routing probe: fieldHash=629058db4926d64e; waves 1-4 spawn at the enemy core (81,224), path toward the player core (81,26), and reduce the path distance from 1533 to 1165-1177 while the stocked Duo consumes ammo. features.name: Turret Targeting, Ammo Feed, Projectiles & Unit Destruction
features.notes: Duo/Scatter targeting, ammo consumption, bullet hits, and kills are ARM11-verified in probes and multiplayer. Live offline bullet draw is wired, and visible turrets now use the stock turret draw over the cached base, adding barrels, ammo, liquid and heat (host: 29-registry, base=8, duo-barrel-l/r at 37->-53, heat=ok, liquid=no-region). The stock EffectState group now advances and draws for the graphical client, so server EffectCallPackets and locally spawned Fx render bullet impacts and lightning arcs with the pinned v160.8 renderers (host: lightning=arc explosion=impact draw=2 packet=ok cleanup=ok); the upstream Effect gate is adapted through port.render.UpstreamEffectGate because the port has no desktop Renderer, and the original gate is unchanged otherwise. Turret beam bullet classes draw through the same client path (host: laser, shrapnel, continuous, pointlaser). Client status timers now advance for statuses applied by client bullet hits, using the stock Statusc API and StatusEffect data, and the stock status Fx spawns with the pinned chance/offset/colour rules (host: tick=stock expire=burning permanent=boss fx=ok); periodic status damage stays server-authoritative. The stock turret drawer also applies the pinned recoilOffset (host: rest=276.75 recoiled=273.75 offset=3). Software complete: the 29-turret registry, barrels, heat, recoil, beam bullets, impact effects and status application are all host-verified.

features.name: Complete Unit Types (Mechs/Legs/Naval/Bosses) & Player Aim/Fire
features.notes: The JVM draws all 68 world-spawnable v160.8 units. Both Azahar profiles drew representative enemies, vehicles, missiles and carried units offline or with the stock Java server. The unified client drives stock player aim and fire in both modes. The stock Gamma and a remote Dagger draw live projectiles and clear them on release. Host ability checks cover all four stock drawable ability classes used by units (forcefield=quasar:19, energyfield=aegires:75, suppressionfield=navanax:40, shieldarc=tecta:56); no stock unit uses ArmorPlate, UnitSpawn or MoveLightning. The ShieldArc renderer-null path is patched alongside ForceField. Software complete.

features.name: Dynamic Lighting, Weather, Particle Effects & Camera Zoom
features.notes: Offline and multiplayer clients advance the stock weather entities, particle/debris layers and puddles; both Azahar profiles sampled active rain/sandstorm/fog and stock puddles. The stock EffectState group now advances and draws with the pinned v160.8 Effect renderers, so server EffectCallPackets and local Fx provide the lightning, impact and dust layers instead of being dropped (host: lightning=arc explosion=impact draw=2 packet=ok cleanup=ok). The building pass invokes stock drawLight for visible emitters when map lighting is enabled, using its radial requests with the handheld additive circle-shadow sprite. Non-radial `Drawf.light` segment and textured-region calls now route through UpstreamBuildingLights when the desktop renderer is absent (host: UPSTREAM_LIGHT_PATHS line=ok textured=ok quads=1 sprites=1). The host reference checks the illuminator and the silicon smelter's idle and warm states. The stock world darkness pass restores the viewport pixels after a live map area change in New 3DS Azahar. The New 3DS replay verified original tile shadow filtering and removal for a large wall and a natural wall. The full stock light buffer remains open. Live camera zoom is wired to the New 3DS C-Stick (0.5x-2x, 8x6-32x24 tile span) with host checks; physical draw is pending the New 3DS acceptance run.

features.name: Mindustry Logic VM (LogicOp / LExecutor) Parity
features.notes: The pinned upstream LogicOp/LExecutor implementation runs inside the live offline and multiplayer ARM11 clients. Saved processor programs, three links, original logic IDs and client-only Canvas writes were verified in Azahar on both profiles and through Java-server save readback. The new host probe now covers the whole VM surface that is independent of a world: all 52 stock LExecutor instruction classes are present, all 45 LogicOp opcodes execute through OpI and match the pinned functions, all 8 ConditionOp values drive SelectI correctly, and jump taken/fall-through, end, stop, print, printchar, format, packcolor and unpackcolor are asserted (UPSTREAM_LOGIC_INSTRUCTIONS classes=52 ops=45 conditions=8 jump=ok end=ok print=ok format=ok color=ok). World- and unit-bound instructions (link, read/write, sensor, radar, unit control, world processors) execute in the Azahar offline and live replays cited above. The handheld logic editor is tracked by logic-processors-displays.
